units.text: The January 1, 1863 Emancipation Proclamation issued in Washington, D.C., applied only in the ten states still in rebellion and explicitly exempted New Orleans and surrounding parishes as Union-controlled.

judgement.reason: The passages support that the proclamation applied only in the ten rebel states and explicitly exempted New Orleans and nearby parishes as Union-controlled, but they do not state it was issued in Washington, D.C.

units.text: The Final Emancipation Proclamation designated areas in rebellion and areas under Union control, explicitly exempting the city of New Orleans and parishes in Louisiana from coverage.
